findings.claim: README.md:77 says only subagents are routed and the main conversation keeps your model; the main conversation is where most spend is
Before this change the plugin put no effort cap on hard or long tasks and let any task reach Haiku, including judging agents under pace pressure
The daily report's 'Saved' figure (7%) counts subagents only, so the biggest lever (main conversations on Opus, 88% of main spend) did not show
The report flagged a planned 'Cold review round 2' as a redo of round 1
Anthropic's Haiku-subagent test saved 32% for about 4 points of pass rate, and low effort skips checks in long Haiku prompts (the basis of the Haiku rules)
A plugin cannot set the main conversation's model or effort (the reason item 1 builds no hook)
Outcome signals (retry, rescue, fixer afterwards, failed tools) are enough to improve tier rules over time
